infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: App4Her uses location to suggest nearby safe places and share location with trusted contacts during safety flows.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: App4Her does not use tracking; this prototype keeps data local.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: App4Her needs your location to find nearby staffed safe places.

plugins.photosPermission: App4Her allows optional media evidence for incident records stored on device.

plugins.cameraPermission: App4Her uses camera for room safety scan preview.

plugins.contactsPermission: App4Her uses contacts to quickly add trusted safety contacts.
